question: The literacy rate is defined by the percentage of the population of a given age group that can ___.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Read and Write**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **literacy rate** is a measure of the percentage of people in a specific age group who can **read and write** with understanding, in any language. 
 
• It reflects the basic educational level of a population, indicating their ability to engage with written content effectively.
 
• These are fundamental skills for communication, education, and participation in society. It is not limited to reading or writing alone.
 
• Most countries and international organizations, including the UNESCO, define literacy as the ability to read and write simple statements or text in any language, even if the person is not fully fluent in that language.
 
• The literacy rate is typically calculated for individuals above a certain age, usually 15 years and older, to assess the educational attainment of a country or region.
 
• The standard definition of literacy may vary slightly depending on local contexts and educational systems, but the core concept remains the ability to **read and write**.
